correctness.rationale: For every odd prime and every 0<t<1/2, normal convergence of mask product excludes spurious infinite-product zeros; a two-unimodular-root cosine rigidity argument identifies each exceptional t uniquely. p-adic valuations show at most one vanishing mask factor and classify its exact frequency cylinders; two residue pairs per level plus a vanishing tail bound rigorously give density 2/[p^{2(k-1)}(p^2-1)] and finite-level counts. Modulo reduction proves nesting or disjointness, and increasing conductor yields the dense Thomae continuity/discontinuity law. The standalone finite numerical and exact-symbolic tests are supplementary, not an infinite proof.
